SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, sv.`stock` , sv.begin_time , sv.end_time FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND v.status = 1
AND (sv.voucher_id IS NULL OR (sv.begin_time <= NOW() AND sv.end_time >= NOW()))
